changelog:
v2.8.3 — 🛠 EMPIRE TALK CRASH FIX

Found and killed the crash: network polling loops were running on the main thread — Android kills any app that does that. All Empire Talk network calls now run on the background IO dispatcher. Calls, chats, and the Recent Chats hub should now be stable.

Also new: crash telemetry. If anything ever crashes again, the exact error trace + device info reach the developer automatically — no cable, no PC needed.

And the updater got smarter: a weak connection that truncates the download now triggers a friendly auto-retry instead of the scary security message.

HOW TO USE: Update Center → check → install v2.8.3 → Empire Talk → claim your handle.
